column3: “And saw” and “standing” are added; “previously” renders πρώτη (“first”).
“Carnelian” renders σαρδίῳ (“sardius”); “gleamed” and “encircled” recast the verbless clauses.
BSB follows the critical-text order “lightning, rumblings, thunder.” “Torches” renders λαμπάδες; BSB puts the verbs in the past.
“As clear as” renders “like”; “in the center, around the throne” renders “in the midst of the throne and around the throne.”
“Covered with” renders “full of”; “they never stop saying” renders “they have no rest … saying.”
BSB uses the present (“fall … worship … cast”); the Greek has the future.
BSB follows the critical text with “our Lord and God” (the Textus Receptus has “O Lord”). BSB has no “the Holy One” (ἅγιος); “they exist” renders ἦσαν (“they were”).
